categories.question: Your favourite team has a long break between matches. What do you do in the arena?

outcomes.name: Start a banner wave
outcomes.description: A fan raising a large colourful supporter banner above a crowd of hands

outcomes.name: Chart the last match
outcomes.description: A spectator tracing a line on a small map with coloured magnetic pieces

outcomes.name: Trade team pins
outcomes.description: Two hands swapping bright enamel team pins over a lanyard

outcomes.name: Meet the mascot
outcomes.description: A fan giving a high five to a cheerful original fox mascot
